limitations: Selected visual review only; unviewed images retain producer review and are not independently approved here.
Conceptual scene/prop continuity checks do not validate engine navigation, collision, mechanical safety or native animation.
Empty staging and separate props do not establish consent, paid accounts, legal import, available inventory or resolved quests.

findings.finding: Two panels have separate clear street-return gaps. Two damaged plates are on the left inspection table, with old/new-looking stock racks apart; right public sample counter shows a plain cloth on a support and geometric tokens without readable names or addresses. Private storage cannot be clearly distinguished behind the window: the locked rear door is not proof of a separate locked contact cabinet. Preserve physically separate identity/contact and technical records before gameplay use. Additional armor stock is decorative, not verified available inventory; the sample’s presence does not authorize identity disclosure.

Left apparatus contains a detached breastplate on an empty wooden stand, suspended mass, straw impact area, buckle and rope separation from the foreground path. No live wearer, injury picture or forced pain demonstration appears. The generic hand advertisement is not evidence that no one was injured or that the advertisement has already been corrected. Right room has thick-grip tools, closed cupboard and independent return. However the screen stands to the RIGHT of the chair rather than between chair and front doorway; the seat remains directly visible from the public approach. Reposition or extend the screen before claiming private bodily consultation. The hanging mass lacks a clearly demonstrated independent lock/stop control; safe testing is not certified by the neutral pose.

Four stages visibly progress from closed catch to open catch, folded side padding and padding resting beside the shell. No person or forced bodily inspection is depicted. The removable element is a small side pad, while collar/rear lining remains visibly installed in frame 4; do not label this complete armor-lining removal. Side-pad edge/quilting, table legs and support details drift across panels, and the final pad shape does not exactly preserve the unfolded silhouette. Usable as a sample-side-pad unhooking storyboard, not a validated aligned animation. Actual sample authorization remains independent.

overall: Selected empty-test and privacy concepts preserve no-forced-body-test intent, but 77 needs genuine doorway-to-seat screening. 78 depicts side-pad removal only, with continuity drift.
